name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, open-source toolkit of ready-made visual building blocks (buttons, forms, layouts) that both human designers and AI coding assistants can use to build an app's look and feel consistently.
buyer: A startup's first product designer or engineer who needs a professional, consistent UI fast without hiring a design team or buying a commercial design-system license.
business_use_cases: A two-person SaaS startup skips hiring a designer and ships a polished-looking product by building entirely on Astryx's components.
A design agency builds a library of 'skins' on top of Astryx and resells them as instant brand kits to small-business clients.
A no-code/low-code tool vendor integrates Astryx as its underlying component system so customers get a professional look out of the box.

money_ideas.idea: Paid premium theme packs (industry-specific skins: fintech, healthcare, e-commerce) built on top of the free system
Done-for-you setup service that configures Astryx and a brand theme for a client's app in a day

steal_this: Build and sell three polished theme packs (e.g. 'SaaS dark mode', 'fintech dashboard', 'e-commerce storefront') on top of Astryx's components on a marketplace like Gumroad.
